# /crav1-merge-pr

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From commit to merge](../../from-commit.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-merge-pr/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Merge one named pull request with a merge commit.

Merge one named pull request only when that turn asks; always a merge commit; no squash, rebase, or policy bypass. After the completed re-read, two parents are confirmed with `git rev-list` (commits API if git cannot see the commit). Does not run [`/crav1-review-pr`](crav1-review-pr.md). Stops when a required host check is red.

1.64.0: after a confirmed merge, says `<n> of <m> branches of <slug> now merged into <target>` per spec. No file edits.

1.66.0: a branch that is behind the base or has conflicts gets one line: merge the base into the branch, push, then ask to merge again. Never a rebase.

1.68.0: after a sub-branch merge, says `<n> of <m> sub-branches merged into <spec branch>` and any `left behind` branch; a reverted branch shows `merged, reverted on <base> (<sha>)`, report only.

## Runs when

This turn asks to merge a named pull request. Called by the user.

## Reads

In short: That named pull request.

Reads one named pull request.

## Writes

In short: A merge commit on the host, a fast-forward of the local default branch when the tree is clean, and the PR note in the specs repo.

Writes a merge commit on the host, and fast-forwards local default when the tree is clean after a confirmed two-parent merge. Then writes or reuses the PR note in the specs repo's `docs/notes/YYYY-MM/` (not committed).

## Does not

Leaves squash, rebase, branch deletion, and work-item links alone.

Limits and exceptions: a required red host check stops it. It does not run [`/crav1-review-pr`](crav1-review-pr.md).

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: [`/crav1-refresh-system-notes`](crav1-refresh-system-notes.md) after an outside pull request merges; [`/crav1-finalize-commit`](crav1-finalize-commit.md)
- Runs by itself: Calls no skill.
